name: Inge King
legacy: This person was at the forefront of the development of non-figurative sculpture in Australia.

checks.lead: Ingeborg Viktoria "Inge" King  (née Neufeld; 26 November 1915 – 23 April 2016) was a German-born Australian sculptor. She received many significant public commissions. Her work is held in public and private collections. Her best known work is Forward Surge (1974) at the Melbourne Arts Centre. She became a Member of the Order of Australia in January 1984.
